title: CLAUDE.md
text: zucbor R package encodes decodes CBOR (RFC 8949) ordinary R vectors lists, using vendored copy TinyCBOR C library system library required. CBOR JSON’s binary counterpart — maps, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null — plus native byte strings, exact 64-bit integers, semantic tags (dates, bignums, UUIDs). Intended properties shape every design decision: Decoding accepts raw vectors, files connections; validates structure building R object; enforces configurable depth size limits, input expected untrusted (network, IoT devices). Encoding deterministic: identical R objects produce identical bytes. Target uses: COSE WebAuthn passkey data, CWT tokens, CoAP device telemetry, IETF protocols moved JSON CBOR. fourth self-describing format family zujson, zuyaml zuxml (sibling checkouts ../). design question answered , look packages settle inventing something new — ../zujson/CLAUDE.md ../zuxml/CLAUDE.md detailed.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: zujson/zuxml built; follow unless CBOR-specific reason . Vendored sources never edited place. live src/vendor/<lib>/, byte-identical pinned upstream release, refreshed script tools/. Local configuration goes project-owned header outside vendor tree. Portable make src/Makevars: list object files OBJECTS hand (R auto-compiles src/*.c, subdirectories), GNU-make features $(wildcard) $(shell), cost SystemRequirements: GNU make. Keep Makevars.win step. Keep .o/./.dll build tarball via .Rbuildignore. Naming: R exports use format prefix (json_parse/xml_parse → presumably cbor_*), R C internals use zu_, .Call entry points use zucbor_. Errors classed conditions, inheriting package base class (e.g. zujson_error), raised C cause known. Tests assert condition class, never message text. Heap state must survive longjmp owned R (finalized external pointers), since Rf_error(), R_CheckUserInterrupt() R allocators jump past free(). Tests self-sufficient (inputs built inside test_that()), pass shuffle = TRUE, stay serial (Config/testthat/parallel, gctorture/valgrind CI legs actually exercise C code), keep suite seconds CRAN. Prose en-GB (Language: en-GB DESCRIPTION siblings), domain terms inst/WORDLIST via spelling::update_wordlist(). Design documents live .agents/. Keep design.md’s mapping tables sync roxygen docs tests: table three times.
